title: Developed Swordsmith shop-keeper game in a month thinking of releasing soon.
author: Gold_Move6034
selftext:
So I've been working on this Swordsmith game for about a month. I'm thinking of releasing it pretty soon, there are some things that need to be added. But overall game core loop seems to be done.

The game is about a Swordsmith who carries over his masters will to keep the Shop running and pay off his debts. Sells weapons to Customers whether they are traveling merchants, knights, mercenaries. Inside the game are interesting game events that make it harder to pay off your debts.

Here is steam page if anyone is interested in wishlisting the game:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4755580/Swordsmith\_of\_Greyhaven/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4755580/Swordsmith_of_Greyhaven/)

If you got any ideas on how I could expand this game, I'd like to know, feedback is much appreciated!

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body: I like the look, you should add some items on the shop counter though.

replies.author: Gold_Move6034
replies.body: The thing is customers themselves will leave some items on the counter - it will trigger an event/quest.

comments.author: Conscious_Regret_140
comments.body: I would suggest you use an hour or two to clean up the characters, that would take them from very obvious ai import to more stylized, proper looking pixel art.

replies.author: Gold_Move6034
replies.body: Yeah, I know what you mean, I'm thinking of redoing all the sprites, honestly not too satisfied with how they turned out.

replies.author: Conscious_Regret_140
replies.body: Draw over them with a smaller palette maybe? Cool idea though, looking forward to see what the game becomes.
